brezhnev.title: On the uniformization of algebraic curves
brezhnev.author: Yu. V. Brezhnev
locators: paper pp.239-240 / PDF pageno 6-7: Burnside curve y^2=x^5-x, G_x=Gamma(4), six singular/branch values {0,+/-1,+/-i,infinity}, and fundamental 10-gon P_x

paper pp.241-243 / PDF pageno 8-10: explicit rank-9 genus-2 group generators T0..T8, P=P_x union V0(P_x), Figure 2 fundamental 18-gon, and topological relation to punctures plus a canonical genus-2 cycle basis
paper p.244 / PDF pageno 11: conformal map chi, disc normalization, Figure 3 branch-labelled star, and explicit statement that the boundary of P_x is not unique
paper p.245 / PDF pageno 12: Gamma(1)-triangle vertices corresponding to branch points {0,+/-1,+/-i,infinity} and Figure 4 incomplete triangulation of one sheet P_x
paper p.248 / PDF pageno 15: explicit theta normalization x=theta4(tau)/theta3(tau), y=4*i*eta(2tau)^3/theta3(tau)^3

source_exact_data.figure4_semantics: incomplete Gamma(1)-triangulation of one sheet P_x with algebraic branch values attached to triangle vertices/arcs

algebraic_branch_labels_to_brezhnev_modu.reason: Figures 3-4 and the explicit theta uniformization attach the algebraic x-values to Brezhnev's own Gamma(4)/Gamma(1) polygonal presentation.

brezhnev_polygon_to_kuusalo_figure9_side.missing: No source formula identifies Brezhnev P_x/P sides or T_k with Kuusalo Figure-9 side numbers 1,2,3,4 or the canonical (a1,a2,b1,b2) side relations.

brezhnev_triangulation_to_kuusalo_figure.missing: Brezhnev's Gamma(1) triangulation is not source-identified with Kuusalo's 16-triangle regular-octagon triangulation or its chosen order-3 center P.

explicit_named_canonical_h1_cycle_assign.missing: Brezhnev states that the nine generators correspond topologically to five punctures plus a canonical base of four genus-2 cycles, but does not assign named T_k to a1,a2,b1,b2.

kuusalo_f2_algebraic_mobius_formula.missing: Brezhnev does not identify an order-3 reduced automorphism with Kuusalo f2 or give an adapter from his polygon to that chosen triangle-center rotation.

source_nonuniqueness_and_gauge.genus2_polygon_copy_choice: The genus-2 polygon must contain two arbitrary neighbouring copies of P_x.
source_nonuniqueness_and_gauge.source_statement_semantics: The shape depends on a boundary of fundamental polygon P_x, and that boundary is not unique.
source_nonuniqueness_and_gauge.consequence_for_ex4: Brezhnev's own explicit branch-labelled uniformization is genuine new marked data, but its source conventions do not fix the inter-presentation gauge required to identify a Kuusalo Figure-9 side phase or Figure-10 triangle.

comparison_to_r5.new_information_over_r5: An independent explicit theta/Fuchsian uniformization attaches the six algebraic branch values to a concrete Gamma(4) polygon, genus-2 18-gon, and modular triangulation.
why_it_does_not_prune_k: R5 already knew the algebraic branch cyclic order and the [infinity,+1] ray; the missing datum is the attachment of those labels to Kuusalo's canonical side numbers / chosen triangle P.
Brezhnev uses a different 10-gon/18-gon modular presentation and supplies no exact conjugating homeomorphism or homology matrix to Kuusalo's regular octagon.
The source explicitly retains polygon-boundary/copy choices, and its topological canonical-cycle statement is unnamed at the generator level.

decision.next_source_candidate: A. Hulpke, T. Kuusalo, M. Naatanen, G. Rosenberger, On orbifold coverings of genus 2 surfaces (2005), Example 1: Bolza regular octagon inside (2,4,8)/(2,3,8) triangle-group geometry with explicit S,T,U and surface-group words.
decision.next_question: Can the triangle-group placement independently bind the regular-octagon side/triangle phase to the algebraic Bolza labels, rather than merely giving another unlabelled octagon presentation?
